data.body: Post-fix box evidence: 1 s sampler over the whole review-bot container (PID 1 /sbin/docker-init) 2026-11-22 20:57-21:27 PST covered the full review of change 3530 (review_step clone/snapshot/diff_fetch/llm_review from 20:56:46 PST) including the clone fetch and 4 tickets-store maintenance runs that hit their 120 s bound (21:05:53, 21:07:59, 21:10:02, 21:12:06 PST). Before the fix each of those left a [git] <defunct> under PID 1 (sampler 19:32-20:02 PST: 8). After: 0 zombies at every sample, 0 at the end. The container was recreated again at 21:25:51 PST by the autodeploy of c924c0ea2e8 (init still set via compose). Remaining for AC2: a full day of no <defunct> older than 1 minute. Next check: sample docker top compose-review-bot-1 -eo stat,etimes for Z with etimes>60 periodically through 2026-11-23 ~21:30 PST. Also noted: the 120 s maintenance timeouts themselves are newrich-discreet-nettlefish territory.
